title: Retry production deployment with domain awake01

requirements.summary: Set production deployment domain to "awake01" (only domain change) to satisfy naming rules and allow a successful redeploy.
acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment is triggered with the domain set to "awake01".
The domain "awake01" is accepted by the deployment validator (length and character rules).
Deployment completes successfully and the app is reachable at the resulting production URL for domain "awake01".

file_operations.description: Create a single-source deployment domain config containing only the production domain value "awake01" so the deployment process can be re-run without any application feature/UI changes. (No component usage.)

Add minimal redeploy instructions stating that production must be redeployed with domain "awake01" and that no other app/UI changes should be made; document the platform naming rules (5–50 chars; letters, numbers, hyphens only). (No component usage.)
